summary: Galiano Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, announcing its annual general and special meeting (AGM) to be held virtually on June 11, 2026. The AGM agenda includes receiving audited financials, fixing board size at eight, electing director nominees (current slate of eight), appointing auditors, approving an omnibus equity incentive plan, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. Materials were filed via notice-and-access on SEDAR+ and EDGAR. This is a routine notice of shareholder meeting and proxy circular; no special-situation transaction or corporate event is involved. Classification: None.
